title: Ripley golfers hit the links | Jackson Star and Herald - Ripley and Ravenswood | wvnews.com
text:
RIPLEY, W.Va. (WV News) - Ripley's golf team continues to be busy with the calendar flipping to September.
In the West Virginia Secondary School Activities Commission Girls State Invitational on the Woodbridge links near Mineral Wells.
RIPLEY, W.Va. (WV News) - Ripley's golf team continues to be busy with the calendar flipping to September.
In the West Virginia Secondary School Activities Commission Girls State Invitational on the Woodbridge links near Mineral Wells.
Bristol Smith finished 11th out of 88 golfers, firing an 86.
Lilah Hosaflook (107), Jaycee Kelly (123), Abigail Kennedy (125) and Gianna Curry (140) also were out on the course for Joel Miller's squad.
Ripley faced off with Ravenswood, Roane and Scott last Wednesday at the Route 56 Golf Course.
Ripley won with a 165. Roane had 211 and Scott finished at 224. Ravenswood fields just a two-man team.
Austin Donohew picked up medalist honors with a 39. Cameron Good (41), Kyler Doss (41), Bristol Smith (44), Owen Pitts (46), Lars Cooper (47), Cash Clendenin (52), Wyatt Holley (53), Brennan Pursley (53) and Sawyer Redman (55) all golfed for the Vikings.
